feeds.title: Cookies and Cups
feeds.description: Cookies & Cups features hundreds of easy desserts and quick dinner ideas you'll love. From the BEST Classic Cheesecake recipe to Crock Pot Crack Chicken! Cookies & Cups is a full dessert resource website. We specialize in simple recipes for all occasions perfect for the home cook. Run by Shelly.

feeds.title: Spend With Pennies
feeds.description: Browse hundreds of easy and delicious recipes tried and tested to be perfect the first time and every time! Features easy recipes, home tips, time savers and more from Holly, a wife, mother of 4, wine and cheese lover, recipe creator, shopping enthusiast, and self-appointed foodie.

feeds.title: Boozy Burbs
feeds.description: Boozy Burbs is your not-so-secret ingredient to discovering the latest dining, drinking & nightlife news in Greater Bergen County. This includes bordering towns in Rockland, Hudson, Essex and Passaic counties.

feeds.title: Community Food Bank of New Jersey Blog
feeds.description: Learn about hunger statistics in New Jersey, what to donate to a foodbank, CFBNJ news, and more at the CFBNJ blog. The Community FoodBank of New Jersey, a member of Feeding America, provides people across the state with food, help, and hope. CFBNJ distributed enough food for more than 85 million nutritious meals last year.

feeds.title: Simple and Savory
feeds.description: A recipe blog that features deliciously healthy recipes that are made with real food, easy to prepare, and can be adapted to suit most diets. Anne's goal is to help make your healthy cooking experiences easy and enjoyable with her recipes.

feeds.title: Jersey Girl Cooks
feeds.description: If you need easy recipes, you can get them here. From appetizers and snacks to entrees and sides to desserts, I have something for every meal of the day. Hi, I'm Lisa. The Jersey Girl Cooks food blog was started in 2008. I love creating recipes and cooking for my family and friends.

feeds.title: The Food Bank of South Jersey Blog
feeds.description: The Food Bank of South Jersey exists to provide an immediate solution to the urgent problem of hunger by providing food to people in need, teaching them to eat nutritiously, and helping them to find sustainable ways to improve their lives. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates on our events, initiative and more!

feeds.title: Fulfill NJ Blog
feeds.description: The FoodBank of Monmouth & Ocean Counties is now Fulfill. We've changed our name, because we're doing more than ever to change lives in our communities for the better. Our new name reflects the fact that today we focus on more than food distribution. It reflects our commitment to fulfill more of the needs of our neighbours and win the battle against hunger. Our blog features the latest news and stories of our people, food initiatives, updates and more!

feeds.title: Courtney's Sweets
feeds.description: Quick and easy recipes! Courtney's Sweets is a family-friendly blog. You'll find easy-to-make recipes, especially in the air fryer as well as kid-friendly recipes, allergy-friendly recipes like dairy-free recipes, peanut-free recipes, and more!

feeds.title: Know Your Produce
feeds.description: Know Your Produce is your source for all things produce, tutorials, tips, resources, and seasonal recipes with fruits and veggies in every Meal. Authors and Couple Courtney and Chris love creating healthy and delicious recipes using fresh seasonal produce and also share about nutrition and benefits whenever possible.

feeds.title: Jersey Bites
feeds.description: Jersey Bites is New Jersey's leading Source for Food News and Restaurant Reviews. Recipes, Food Events, and more. Launched in 2007, Jersey Bites began as a home to Deborah's growing collection of recipes, but soon grew into a hub for food news throughout the Garden State.

feeds.title: Backpacking Chef
feeds.description: Find recipes for breakfasts, lunches, dinners, snacks, and desserts. I'm Chef Glenn. My posts give tips on how to dehydrate backpacking food, and they aim to inspire you to create your own meals with healthy ingredients and a food dehydrator.

feeds.title: South Jersey Food Scene
feeds.description: Welcome to South Jersey Food Scene. South Jersey food commentary, news, restaurant reviews, and anything to do with the South Jersey food/drink scene.

feeds.title: I Just Want To Eat! Blog
feeds.description: I Just Want To Eat is a personal blog that me, Jean-Philippe Gerbi, decided to create back in July 2011. I love food, talking about food and experienced different types of cuisine during the years I traveled around the world. I do not know if it is because of my French palate and the different food I have been exposed to, but trust me: I can eat any type of food. On this blog, you will find information about places where I eat (whether in New York, New Jersey or anywhere where I travel), recipes and various information related to food.

feeds.title: Give it Some Thyme
feeds.description: Here you'll browse a range of delicious wholesome recipes to inspire easy, healthy cooking from the comfort of your home. I'm Kim, creator, and author of Give it Some Thyme. This is our family food blog, cataloging a growing collection of approachable, crowd-pleasing, and most-requested recipes for the everyday home chef.

feeds.title: Lynn Hazan » Food
feeds.description: Explore various popular and hidden treasures of restaurants, cafes, stalls and more in New Jersey here. LynnHazan.com is a blog based in Jersey City, NJ that covers news and culture in Hudson County and beyond. Our mission is to inspire, educate, inform, and entertain our readers; from new businesses to support and local initiatives that need attention to personal stories.

feeds.title: JCFamilies Blog » Restaurants in Jersey City/Hoboken
feeds.description: Since 2010, JCFamilies has been dedicated to serving and supporting families in Jersey City and surrounding areas. JCFamilies provides critical resources to families and its rapidly growing community of savvy and socially connected local parents from diverse backgrounds. Find the places to eat, restaurants, tips, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Mantra Jersey City Blog
feeds.description: Spices, flavors, and more, exploring the World of Indian Cuisine. At Mantra, our philosophy is to emphasize refined and creative Indian cuisine. The menu incorporates both traditional classic favorites and original new dishes that apply Eastern flavors with a Western twist. Our focus is to provide first-class service and an engaging atmosphere all across.

feeds.title: Prato Bakery Blog
feeds.description: Prato Bakery is a little bakery with Italian style, where everyday our master bakers produce our baked goods.

feeds.title: Jersey Italian Gravy Blog
feeds.description: Get sizzling new recipes, hot new deals and exclusive updates in our blog. Jersey Italian Gravy was developed by Carlos and Constance Vega as a simple solution for foodies everywhere. Classic Italian flavor, made with few, fresh, organic ingredients, that will leave you wanting seconds again and again.

feeds.title: Lachetti's Blog
feeds.description: John and Cheryl Iachetti deliver a new kind of restaurant to Glen Rock - one where the ingredients are always fresh, the staff is always friendly, and where you always feel right at home, no matter the occasion. Stay up to date with the latest news, updates, recipes and more from Glen Rock's Brick Oven Kitchen.

feeds.title: Kris Craves Blog » New Jersey
feeds.description: Kris Craves is a food and travel blog where I share all of our favorite eats. New Jersey's restaurants offer some of the most underrated culinary delights in the USA. Get reviews and tips from my favorite places in the Garden State.

feeds.title: Stacey Snacks
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Stacey! I live 20 miles from NYC, and have access to some great markets & restaurants. I am an antiques dealer & appraiser during the day and a recipe writer, and a cook by night. I use fresh, local, seasonal ingredients to create delicious meals. Check out my weekly recipes on my blog.

feeds.title: Hoboken Girl » Food + Drink
feeds.description: Welcome to HobokenGirl.com. Our team lives, breathes, eats, and drinks Hoboken and Jersey City lifestyle topics, and knows that Hudson County is a unique place filled with entrepreneurs, young professionals, and families. Discover restaurants, local places, recipes, and more in the food and drink section of Hoboken Girl.

feeds.title: Best of NJ » Food
feeds.description: If you're looking for the hottest new places to eat in New Jersey, then you've come to the right place! Best of NJ is home to the best food features. We aim to be The Best of New Jersey, All in One Place. More specifically, we are a lifestyle and tourism website showcasing all the things that make our state so great. Every time you visit Best of NJ, you'll find stories, events, and businesses that highlight and exemplify Garden State's greatness.
